method: Actual artifact-first inspection of v2, v3, the bound editorial reference and 720/360 proof, plus explicit judgments against the eight STILL failure definitions. No human review claimed.

results.reason: Reject style drift: inspected v2 generic muted laptop and rejected it against the adult editorial reference; visible halftone alone was insufficient.
Reject invented canon: a named person or town location cannot be admitted by this keyboard-only brief.
Reject impossible hardware: keys on unsupported or disconnected surfaces would contradict the physical keyboard job.
Reject malformed bodies or hands: no biological subject is authorized or required for this image.
Reject false text: the required key labels are exactly Alt and Space; gibberish or additional app copy would fail.
Reject era drift: unrelated historical equipment or wardrobe cannot substitute for contemporary keyboard hardware.
Reject semantic mismatch: v2 blank panes did not communicate the actual shortcut and was rejected.
Reject irrelevant decoration: v2 generic scene did not give its large empty panes a sufficient explanatory purpose.
